column1: # Forever Blacksmithing: the recipe file of spec jvbastel/WOWAI#225. forever/generator makes the recipe spells
# (client Spell.dbc and SkillLineAbility.dbc in the client data patch, forever_spell_template and
# forever_skill_line_ability on the server) from it. The items that the recipes make are in items.tsv.
# Never edit a generated file by hand. To gather the data again, see forever/REFRESH.md.
# Source: WoW Forever build 1.60.1.70685, recorded 2026-10-30: the local Forever client (its SkillLineAbility,
# SpellReagents, SpellEffect and SpellCastingRequirements tables; the dump fv_new_recipes.tsv of #224). Only
# numbers and names come from the client.
# Free profession spell ID range: 61000-61999. A recipe spell takes its ID from this block of the free spell
# range of warrior.tsv, so that the core can tell a profession spell from a Warrior spell even with the rules
# off. Its skill line ability takes the same ID. Next free profession spell ID: 61374.
#   kind          recipe (a new recipe spell), stock (a stock recipe that Forever changes, #228) or
#                 removed (a stock recipe that Forever took away, #229: only kind, spell, sourceSpell, name,
#                 skillLine, plans and notes; the other columns are -)
#   spell         the spell ID: from the profession spell range for a new recipe, the stock spell for a
#   sourceSpell   the stock recipe spell that the new spell is a copy of: its cast time, tool (Blacksmith
#                 Hammer), icon and visuals stay. A stock row: the same as `spell`
#   name          the recipe name (the craft window and the spell)
#   minRank       the skill that learning the recipe needs (orange from here). A new recipe: its skill line
#                 ability. A stock row: the skill that its trainer rows (forever_npc_trainer) and its plans
#                 (required_skill_rank) need; the stock skill line ability keeps its own value
#   yellow, grey  the colour range: yellow from `yellow`, green from the middle, grey from `grey`
#   reagents      item x count, separated by commas (at most 8)
#   creates       the item that the recipe makes, x count
#   focus         the name of the spell focus object of the stock SpellFocusObject.dbc, for example Anvil,
#   plans         the stock plans item that teaches a stock row, or - (no plans, or a new recipe: #230)
#   foreverSpell  the spell ID of the recipe in the Forever client (the source row of the dump)
# A stock row writes only what differs from stock 1.12: its colour range in place of the stock one, the
# skill of its trainer rows and of its plans, and its reagents, name and focus where they differ from the
# stock spell. A recipe whose stock focus is the Anvil keeps the Anvil where Forever asks for a Master
# --- #226 tracer bullet: one new recipe, crafted at an Anvil from stock reagents.
